messages.content: Calculate the profit margin of a company with revenue of $200,000 and expenses of $150,000.

function.name: calculate_ROI
function.description: Calculate the Return on Investment (ROI) for a given investment amount and net profit. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

investment_amount.description: The initial amount of money invested. This is a float type value.

net_profit.description: The profit made from the investment. This is a float type value.

duration_years.description: The duration of the investment in years.

message.content:
Profit margin = (Revenue – Expenses) ÷ Revenue × 100%

 Revenue = $200,000  
 Expenses = $150,000  

Net profit = $200,000 – $150,000 = $50,000  

Profit margin = ($50,000 ÷ $200,000) × 100 % ≈ **25 %**
message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate profit margin. Profit margin formula: (Revenue - Expenses)/Revenue * 100%. They gave revenue=200k, expenses=150k. So profit=50k. Margin=50k/200k*100% = 25%. We can compute manually or use tool? There's no tool for profit margin; only ROI. But we could use ROI function if we treat net profit as 50k, investment maybe not needed. But ROI expects investment_amount and net_profit. We don't have investment_amount. So better do manual calculation.

We should respond with result: 25%.
